lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima are concentrated posterior to the gills, forming a dense cluster of roughly circular pixel regions that decrease in size and increase in spatial frequency towards the dorsal ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming identifiable grid-like nodes primarily in the mid-lateral region of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct linear feature extends horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance shift from high intensity on the dorsal side to a narrow shadow gradient immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: A lower-intensity silhouette of a remora is visible attached to the ventral region; the cranial silhouette exhibits a wide-gape aperture at the leading edge.
